channel.title: FreeMind
channel.description: Updates for FreeMind, a native macOS mind-mapping app.

item.title: v1.2.0
item.description:
FreeMind 1.2.0

备注支持 Markdown

  • 备注框换成所见即所得的 Markdown 编辑器：边输入边显示标题、粗体、斜体、列表、引用、链接
  • 支持 ==高亮== 和 ~~删除线~~
  • 代码块按语言着色：在 ` 后写上语言名即可，比如 `swift
  • 支持数学公式：行内写 $E=mc^2$，独占一行写 $$ … $$
  • 打开备注弹窗后光标直接在输入框里，可以马上输入
  • 原有备注不受影响，文件里保存的仍然是 Markdown 文本

在 GitHub 上查看这次发布 →

FreeMind 1.2.0

Markdown in notes

  • The note box is now a live Markdown editor: headings, bold, italic, lists, quotes and links are shown as you type
  • Supports ==highlight== and ~~strikethrough~~
  • Code blocks are colored by language: put the language name after the opening `, for example `swift
  • Math formulas: write $E=mc^2$ inline, or put $$ … $$ on its own lines for a block
  • The cursor is in the note box as soon as the note popover opens, so you can start typing right away
  • Existing notes are unaffected; files still store the note as Markdown text

item.title: v1.1.0
item.description:
FreeMind 1.1.0

联系线

  • 按住联系线的线条或标签直接拖动就能调整弧度，不用先选中再找控制柄
  • 标签自动错开：几条联系线的标签不再叠在一起，也不会被别的线压住
  • 联系线太多觉得干扰时可以全部隐藏：“显示 ▸ 显示联系线”（⌥⌘L），或右键联系线选“隐藏所有联系线”。隐藏状态随文件保存，状态栏会提示隐藏了几条，点一下恢复显示

其他改进

  • 触控板双指滚动可以往任意方向拖动画布，不再只能水平或垂直
  • 再次打开 FreeMind 时会切换到已经运行的那个，不会同时开出两个

问题修复

  • 备注、超链接、标签等弹出框的内容显示不全

在 GitHub 上查看这次发布 →

FreeMind 1.1.0

Relationships

  • Drag a relationship line or its label to reshape it; no need to select it and find the handles first
  • Labels move apart automatically, so they no longer pile up on top of each other or get crossed by other lines
  • Hide all relationships when they get in the way: View ▸ Show Relationships (⌥⌘L), or right-click a relationship and choose Hide All Relationships. The setting is saved with the file, and the status bar shows how many are hidden; click it to show them again

Other improvements

  • Two-finger scrolling on the trackpad moves the map in any direction instead of only horizontally or vertically
  • Opening FreeMind again switches to the copy that is already running instead of starting a second one

Fixes

  • Notes, hyperlink, label and other popovers were cut off at the edges

item.title: v1.0.0
item.description:
FreeMind 1.0.0

FreeMind 的第一个正式版本：macOS 原生的思维导图应用，操作方式参照 XMind，键盘就能完成大部分编辑。需要 macOS 14 或更高版本。

画导图

  • 五种结构：思维导图、逻辑图（向右 / 向左）、组织结构图、树状图，随时切换
  • 12 套内置风格，背景、分支配色、字体、线宽都能调整，再存成自定义风格
  • 备注、超链接、附件、主题图片、标签、标记、外框、联系线
  • Tab 加子主题、Return 加同级主题，选中后直接打字就能改文字，支持中文输入法
  • ⌘F 查找主题文字、标签和备注

文件

  • .fmind 包格式，附件直接存在文件里；折叠状态、缩放比例和位置随文件保存
  • 导入 Markdown、OPML、XMind（新版和 XMind 8）、纯文本缩进大纲
  • 导出 Markdown、OPML、PNG、PDF，以及打印
  • Finder 里可以看到 .fmind 的缩略图，按空格预览

其他

  • 欢迎窗口列出最近打开的导图；新建时可以从模板库选模板
  • 自动保存、版本浏览、撤销 / 重做、窗口标签页、深色模式
  • 本机 MCP 服务，Claude Code 等 AI Agent 可以读取和编辑打开的导图（设置 ▸ Agent）
  • 自动检查更新（FreeMind ▸ 检查更新…）
  • 中英文界面，跟随系统语言

安装

下载 FreeMind-1.0.0.dmg，打开后把 FreeMind 拖进“应用程序”。App 已用 Developer ID 签名并经过 Apple 公证。

在 GitHub 上查看这次发布 →

FreeMind 1.0.0

The first release of FreeMind, a native macOS mind-mapping app modeled on XMind, built so that most editing can be done from the keyboard. Requires macOS 14 or later.

Mapping

  • Five structures: mind map, logic chart (right / left), org chart and tree chart, switchable at any time
  • 12 built-in themes; adjust background, branch colors, fonts and line widths, then save your own
  • Notes, hyperlinks, attachments, topic images, labels, markers, boundaries and relationships
  • Tab adds a child, Return adds a sibling, and typing on a selected topic edits it (input methods supported)
  • ⌘F searches topic text, labels and notes

Files

  • .fmind package format with attachments stored inside; fold state, zoom and scroll position are saved with the file
  • Import Markdown, OPML, XMind (current and XMind 8) and indented plain-text outlines
  • Export Markdown, OPML, PNG and PDF, or print
  • Finder thumbnails and Quick Look previews for .fmind files

More

  • Welcome window with recent maps; pick a template when creating a new map
  • Autosave, version browsing, undo / redo, window tabs and dark mode
  • Local MCP server so AI agents such as Claude Code can read and edit open maps (Settings ▸ Agent)
  • Automatic update checks (FreeMind ▸ Check for Updates…)
  • English and Chinese interface, following the system language

Install

Download FreeMind-1.0.0.dmg, open it and drag FreeMind into Applications. The app is signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
